numerical.label: Incorrect
numerical.definition: found does not match the expected outcome (false positive or false negative), or the summary is fabricated rather than grounded in tool results.

numerical.label: Partially correct
numerical.definition: found matches the expected outcome, but confidence is miscalibrated or the summary contains ungrounded/unsupported claims.

numerical.label: Correct
numerical.definition: found/confidence match the expected outcome and the summary is grounded in real Companies House data with no fabrication.
